So I went back to fable 5.1 and the dumbification has started to happen AGAIN... when I want the nerd that writes 10 pages of DENSE text non stop I go to opus, fable is more expensive because it has better presets, but now fable 5.1 is starting to go into the uber nerd in adderal area too PLUS starting to do dumb things... I'm in this process of running something, get logs, tune, get logs, tune... and I told the thing multiple tmes... hey create scripts…
